method: 600 owner-unique GitSkills descriptions that matched no G1 keyword rule (random by content hash, G1 owners excluded) labelled by two read-only workers against the capability taxonomy; text treated as untrusted data.
finding: The unclassified 32% is mostly existing domains the rules missed (tool-specific names, project-internal workflows, non-English text), not a large unknown capability class.

worker_summaries.notes: Dominant miss causes: project-internal/agent-harness workflows and CJK/other non-English descriptions; tool-specific product names (Flutter, Jira, OmniFocus, PostgreSQL) also escape generic capability keywords. Candidate domains confirmed by sample: wellbeing-lifestyle (268,274), government-public (33). No hits for energy-environment, manufacturing-industrial, hr-people beyond borderline (125 school admin, 59 lab control).
